A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OLMoE work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison, including the new release documented in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original pretraining and adaptation results, controlled design experiments, and routing analyses in Sections 3–5 and Appendices E–G.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds baseline evaluations and original comparisons involving the January 2025 release in Tables 16–17.

M1.justification: Appendix I introduces a substantive extension to adaptation for OLMoE-1B-7B-0125: a PPO stage using verifier rewards, reported as RLVR, after SFT and DPO. This adds an optimization stage beyond v1's SFT/DPO or KTO procedures. The original MoE architecture and routing mechanism remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Appendix I substantially extends empirical coverage. Table 17 adds evaluations on PopQA, TruthfulQA, DROP, MATH, and HumanEval+, absent from v1's reported evaluation suites. The newer release also uses curated Dolmino annealing data, whose composition is documented in Table 15; several original web and scientific sources are retained.

E2.justification: Table 4 adds Llama3.2-1B. Table 12 adds Llama3.2-1B, Llama3.2-3B, Zamba2-1B, and DeepSeekV2-2B-16B, without removing existing comparators. These are limited extensions of the established comparisons; the OpenMoE parameter-count correction does not introduce a different comparator.

E3.justification: Table 11 and Appendix C change reported in-training answer normalization from tokens to characters for several tasks. Table 10 changes OLMoE warmup from 2,000 to 2,500 steps and minimum LR from 5.0E-04 to 4.0E-05. Appendix I introduces a different annealing mixture and a Tulu evaluation protocol, including MMLU with CoT and length-controlled AlpacaEval 2. The PDFs do not establish that the original experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Table 17 extends adaptation-stage analysis to the new RLVR step: the January model's GSM8K score changes from 64.6 after DPO to 72.4 after RLVR, while its average changes from 49.3 to 49.8. Existing design ablations and routing analyses in Section 4 and Appendices F–G are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests for these comparisons. The added tables retain point estimates; dagger marks denote MCF evaluation rather than statistical significance.

E6.justification: v2 adds substantial results for the January release. Table 16 reports OLMES averages of 71.1 versus 72.7 and MMLU scores of 54.1 versus 56.3 for the September and January models. Under Table 17's separate Tulu protocol, September DPO averages 39.8 and January RLVR 49.8. Tables 4 and 12 also add comparator scores; retained benchmark score entries remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 1 corrects the malformed summation with upper limit Top-k(r(x)) to a sum over indices belonging to Top-k(r(x)). This repairs the formal aggregation expression without changing the procedure described in prose. The routing-analysis definitions and other mathematical content are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the central claims about full openness, performance relative to active parameter count, training design findings, and expert specialization. The new first-page footnote identifies the main report as describing the September release and directs readers to the newer release.

C2.justification: Table 5 drops the diagnosis that the excluded JetMoE chat model 'is broken,' retaining its random scores as the stated reason for exclusion. This modestly narrows the interpretation. The routing explanations and Appendix H's four limitations remain substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix I adds the 100B-token annealing sample description, Dolmino source and sampling information, and access information for the new models and datasets. Table 9 adds the DeepSeekV2-Lite model location. Appendix B and Table 10 correct reported epochs and hyperparameters, while existing hardware and implementation disclosures are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to Zamba, Tulu 3, and 2 OLMo 2 Furious. Zamba extends the related-model discussion; the latter works establish the newer release's recipe provenance. The central novelty positioning remains unchanged. Duplicate-reference removal does not remove the corresponding cited works.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited copyedits, updates author contributions and acknowledgements, and adds a first-page version note plus Appendices I and J. The existing section organization and main narrative are largely retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 15–17 and expands Tables 4, 9, and 12. Table 12 moves from sharing a page with Figure 25 to a separate page, with an expanded caption. The first-page layout is adjusted, while the existing scientific figures and overall visual style are retained.

improvement.justification: Corrections to Equation 1 and the reported training and evaluation settings improve precision, while additional baselines and release comparisons broaden the evidence available to readers. Most original analyses remain unchanged, and the new PPO recipe receives only brief documentation. Small inconsistencies also remain: Appendix J calls Table 10's minimum-LR correction 'max LR.' The net improvement is useful but limited.
